subject: Can a Nerve in Your Ear Wake the Unconscious Brain? The Biophysics of taVNS
script: From Agewell Brief: Can a Nerve in Your Ear Wake the Unconscious Brain? The Biophysics of taVNS. A non-invasive pulse to the vagus nerve is being tested against disorders of consciousness. The mechanism is real, the evidence is early, and the physics runs deep. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
